ne24:2.2: “tasmā rakkhitacitta’ssa sammā saṅkappagocaro”ti idaṃ satindriyaṃ; satindriye gahite gahitāni bhavanti pañcindriyāni.
ne24:2.3: “sammādiṭṭhipurekkhāro”ti sammādiṭṭhiyā gahitāya gahito bhavati ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
ne24:2.5: sammādiṭṭhito hi sammāsaṅkappo pabhavati, sammāsaṅkappato sammāvācā pabhavati, sammāvācato sammākammanto pabhavati, sammākammantato sammāājīvo pabhavati, sammāājivato sammāvāyāmo pabhavati, sammā vāyāmato sammāsati pabhavati, sammāsatito sammāsamādhi pabhavati, sammāsamādhīto sammāvimutti pabhavati, sammāvimuttito sammāvimutti ñāṇadassanaṃ pabhavati.
